title: Goderich Winter Rapid
description:
**Time Control**: 15 + 10 - CFC Rated (quick time control).

 **Round Schedule**: 
 Round 1: 10:00AM 
 Round 2: 11:00AM 
 Round 3: 1:00PM 
 Round 4: 2:00PM 
 Round 5: 3:00PM 

 **Prizes**: Prizes are for all sections. 
 1st place: $100 
 2nd place: $75 
 3rd place: $25 

 **Forfeit Time**: 5 minutes 

 **Sections**: Open & U1500 

 **Registration**: Please obtain a CFC membership before submitting the registration form.  Once you obtain a CFC ID, proceed and please send your $30 entry fee e-transfer to goderichchessclub@gmail.com. Once that's completed, please fill out the register form using the <Register / Inquire> link at the bottom of this message. Registration will close on January 15th, 2026 at 9:00 PM. 
 
 To obtain a CFC membership, please use the <Join the CFC> link at the bottom of this message. For membership fees please use the <CFC Membership - Fees> link at the bottom of this message. 

  **Refund policy:** 
 Tournament Entry Fees 
 • Withdrawing 48 hours or more before the tournament: full refund. 
 • Withdrawing less than 48 hours before the tournament: no refund.
 • No-shows or withdrawing after round 1 has started: no refund.
 • Tournament cancelled by the club: full refund, or a credit toward a future GCC tournament if you prefer. 
 • Tournament postponed: your entry carries over to the new date. If you can't attend the new date, you can ask for a full refund. 
 **Lunch will be provided for free to everyone attending the event** 

 **Tournament Director, Organizer & Arbiter**: FIDE Arbiter Riley Khan 

 Pairings and live results will be available on chess-results.com. Please note that the registration list does not auto-update once you’ve submitted your registration form. 
 Rating sections and round times are subject to change without notice. What you see on this page is the most current date, rating sections, and round times. 
 Unrated players will receive a provisional rating regardless of if they play rated players or not. 
 This tournament will be an over the board (not online) tournament. 

 Parents are welcome to drop off their children and leave, though they are encouraged to stay and enjoy the chess tournament/event. There will a waiting area for parents and for lunch / analysis. 

 **Volunteer hours** 
 Students that would like to volunteer can email goderichchessclub@gmail.com to connect with the tournament director to obtain volunteer hours towards the 40 hours required to graduate with a high school diploma. 

 **Photography Notice** 
 Please note that photos and videos may be taken during this tournament for club records, website, and social media use. By attending or participating, you consent to the use of your image, or your child’s image, for these purposes. Feel free to email us at goderichchessclub@gmail.com if you have any questions or visit our privacy policy page in the footer of our website. 

  For any questions feel free to email us at goderichchessclub@gmail.com
